promises.target: INR 15,000 crore to INR 20,000 crore business
promises.quote: We feel that in next couple of years, this is going to be almost INR 15,000 crore to INR 20,000 crore business for us.
This year itself we feel confident that we are going to be somewhere around INR 6,000 crores in this business.
So the real potential for display business, once it is completely ramped up in next couple of years, it can generate revenues of closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores.
